feedback.delta: Preserve bounded interruptible replay/synthesis/consolidation as an optional cognitive maintenance cycle, but require versioned authoritative state and measurable effects.
Cyclic/background jobs need typed budget, priority, interrupt, checkpoint, resume, effect receipt and idempotence semantics.
Dream-synthesized hypotheses/reflections remain candidates; no broadcast/canonical authority without ordinary evidence.
No unique hyperposition mechanism discovered beyond resumable candidate-state handling.
Represent replay source -> synthesis candidate -> consolidation effect as separate provenance edges; distinguish NO_EFFECT from completion.
Use expected-version/CAS or event-sourced semantics for consolidation writes; stale background workers must not overwrite newer foreground state.
Tests: never-runs despite service healthy, phase-complete/no-effect, interrupt/restart exactly-once, malformed generation quarantine, cross-process stale overwrite, idle-sensor failure.
Do not infer useful integration/consolidation from daemon activity, phase completion or generated self-report.
Historical low-priority consolidation supports bounded cyclic learning slots, including adaptive visual learner scheduling, but self-generated outputs cannot become trusted labels.
Index PF-DREAM-FAIL-001..004 and documentation/runtime-constant drift as reusable validation questions.
